title: Democrats show divisions on Israel amid competitive midterm elections
description: Democratic socialists are on the ballot in high profile races coming up in Michigan and Wisconsin, putting mainstream Democrats in a tough position when it comes to the issue of Israel and Gaza.

title: Trump's noncitizen voter data remains a mystery. But the claims raise midterm fears
description: Trump officials say they found 250,000 noncitizens on voter rolls in just four states. Those states don't know where the numbers came from, and some worry what the claims may portend for the midterms.

title: One Big Beautiful Bill cut healthcare funds. Now, Republicans have to sell the costs
description: Blanketing the airwaves with ads about healthcare, Republican candidates who voted to cut federal funding in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act are positioning themselves as advocates for lower costs.

title: Trump’s claims of election interference in doubt after release of declassified intelligence
description: Declassified evidence points to Beijing seeking personal data for espionage, not election interference.

title: After Fauci Senate hearing, experts worry about 'chilling effect' on public health
description: The accusations against Dr. Anthony Fauci, once the nation's leading infectious disease expert, have some experts worrying that these events may further erode public health staffing in the U.S.

title: Trump's attorney general pick hits resistance from Republicans
description: Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination has run into resistance from Republicans demanding answers about a Justice Department settlement tied to Trump's tax returns.

title: What to know about Republican lame ducks defying Trump over Blanche nomination
description: GOP Sens. John Cornyn (Texas) and Thom Tillis (North Carolina) are leaving the Senate after this year.

title: The Trump administration wants $10 million more to cover its July Fourth celebrations
description: Congress allocated $150 million for 250th birthday events. The Trump-backed group that planned the state fair and July 4th fireworks is asking for an additional $10 million in reimbursements.

title: Trump says he 'may' pull Blanche AG nomination temporarily
description: The news comes as two key Republicans are withholding their support over concerns about the Justice Department's deal with President Trump.

title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court holds its first-ever hearing after 30 years
description: Congress created the Alien Terrorist Removal Court in 1996 to make it easier for the Justice Department to use classified evidence to deport people from U.S. soil.

title: Senate panel delays vote on Blanche's AG nomination as key Republicans voice concerns
description: Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general is up in the air after concerns from two Republicans on the committee that must advance his nomination.

title: Sen. Richard Blumenthal talks about Anthony Fauci's contentious Senate hearing
description: NPR's Michel Martin asks U.S. Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn., for his takeaways from Wednesday's confrontational Senate committee hearing with former top U.S. health official Dr. Anthony Fauci.

title: Mamdani says New York doesn’t have authority to arrest Netanyahu, urges feds to act
description: The mayor had said the city might enforce a warrant against the Israeli leader, drawing Democratic criticism. On Tuesday, he urged the U.S. government to do so.
